scope: Generated media and synthetic review attestations in isolated Chrome on the Windows build host; no real human review or campaign outcome claimed.
limits: No guaranteed viral reach or calibrated performance score.
Actual local-model reasoning and social-account retrieval remain unqualified or absent.
Review means exact-version user attestation, not independent fact verification.
Caption timing is script-derived, not forced-aligned to narration.
No auto-posting, paid generation, dependency installers or private data upload.
